title: Christopher Bogart comments on the third anniversary of the PACCAR decision in Law360
summary: Law360 reports on industry calls to reverse the UK Supreme Court's PACCAR decision, featuring comments from Burford CEO Christopher Bogart urging legislation to restore certainty to the legal finance market. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Law360 reports on industry calls to reverse the UK Supreme Court's PACCAR decision, featuring comments from Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) urging legislation to restore certainty to the legal finance market.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law360.com/articles/2505332/funders-urge-uk-to-undo-paccar-after-3-years-of-limbo)
